title: Stefon Diggs' attorney says teams 'reluctant' to sign WR, addresses NFL future

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Stefon Diggs' attorney says teams 'reluctant' to sign WR, addresses NFL future
sources.description: Stefon Diggs' attorney said NFL teams had "been reluctant to sign him" as he stood trial for strangulation and assault and battery charges.
